values: 30001703 / OWR-4798-030: Swartz's connected closed 3-manifold equality question, OWR 08/2011 pp.409–410; https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46323

Prior full connected-target coverage, jointly credited to Bhaskar Bagchi and Basudeb Datta–Satoshi Murai. Bagchi, European Journal of Combinatorics 51 (2016), 69–83, DOI https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ejc.2015.04.007, proves equality iff stacked; Datta–Murai, Electronic Journal of Combinatorics 24(4) (2017), P4.12, supplies the handle classification. For any fixed field F, Gamma(M)=10 beta1(M;F) exactly for S3 (the empty sum) and finite connected sums of both S2-bundles over S1; equality implies integral H1=Z^k and all-field equality. Freshly inspected Bagchi arXiv:1405.5675v1 Theorem 1.14/Corollary 1.15 and the final Datta–Murai Corollaries 4.6, 4.9/Remark 4.10. Bagchi journal identity authenticated; journal body unavailable. The final Datta–Murai p.7 cutting predicate has a local precursor-membership defect, explicitly repaired to output-face membership and independently checked. The joint coverage uses the separation-index theorem, triangulability and standard duality/handle topology; it is not a claim that the single C DOI independently proves every step or that all foundational/source papers were audited. Existing publications; no new upload, project-authorship or firstness claim. Audit: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1253
